{{Quote|The rest of our crew has been evacuated and heading your way. It's been an honor Admiral. Godspeed, rebels-!|The pilot, to Amilyn Holdo|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''pilot''' served in the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|fleet]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]] and held the [[military rank]] of [[captain]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note" /> during the [[Battle of Oetchi]], he [[pilot]]ed the [[Nebulon-C escort frigate]] [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']]. Attempting to flee from the [[First Order]] with the other Resistance ships, this [[Resistance pilot|pilot's]] ship was the first to run dry. The ship was then destroyed as [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] commented that the ship was the beginning of the end of the Resistance. This pilot elected to remain behind on the ''Anodyne'' whilst the rest of the crew evacuated. He informed [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] of this development and wished them good luck just as the ship was completely destroyed, [[Death|killing]] him.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character was played by [[Danny Sapani]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.theroot.com/in-star-wars-the-last-jedi-john-boyega-people-of-col-1821323399|text=In Star Wars: The Last Jedi, John Boyega, People of Color Get to Shine in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|author=Jason, Johnson|date=2018-12-15|work=The Root|archivedate=20191218182521}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi">{{Film|VIII}} credits</ref> The pilot had a [[Resistance rank badge]] that denoted him as a captain.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
